Model/dataMacromolecule comparison chart; structure/function modelConnect the named structure, variable, or process to function.

A student is reviewing the required visual and must explain the first visible structure-function connection. Which answer uses the lesson evidence most accurately?

generalfeedback.text: Teachable feedback: First, name the macromolecule class. Then use the required stimulus (Biomolecule model/table) to connect the visible evidence to macromolecules as structure-function tools in human physiology. Correct reasoning stays inside MLA.ANP.ORG.02 and avoids the common mistake: memorizing carbohydrates, lipids, proteins, and nucleic acids without a body-function connection.
